text:
deploy-bot: Deployment finished: inference-api v2.14.1-rc2 -> canary (zone us-west-2). rollout=canary, traffic=10%, artifacts: img@sha256:abc123
monitoring-bot: Synthetic: /v1/generate (canary) — 5xx rate: 1.8% -> 6.7% (3m), p50 latency: 120ms -> 430ms. Alert: probe/high-latency, probe-id=gen-canary-001
alice: saw the alert, checking canary logs now. any quick indicators?
ben: looking at runtime logs — seeing repeated "kvcache: miss, expected key v2|prefix" followed by short spikes of 504s. hit rate dropped from ~98% -> 72% for canary.
carol: same. stack traces point to kv-serializer change in v2.14.1-rc2 (diff in PR #4127). suspect cache format mismatch for previously cached entries.
sre-oncall: this is impacting latency SLO and causing user-facing 5xx. recommend pausing rollout and pinning canary traffic back to the last stable (v2.14.0). what’s easier now: traffic pin or full rollback?
alice: we can pin the routing layer for canary subset to v2.14.0 immediately (no full deploy rollback). will do 50% -> v2.14.0 for canary group and monitor.
deploy-bot: Executing control-plane change: canary routing override -> target v2.14.0 for 50% of canary sessions. change-id=chg-789
monitoring-bot: After routing change: /v1/generate (canary) p50=135ms, p95=260ms, 5xx=1.9% (3m). metrics trending back to baseline.
ben: confirmed: prefix cache hit-rate recovering; error traces stop once traffic hits v2.14.0. that confirms serialization/regression in rc2.
carol: I'll open a revert PR for the serializer region and add an explicit migration path + unit test for kv format. also adding a barrier check in the deploy job to validate cache key compatibility.
alice: filing incident ticket INC-2026-87 with summary + timeline; logging rollback decision and impacted customers.
sre-oncall: good. add a temporary synthetic check that asserts cache-hit-rate > 90% for canary after deploy (fail the pipeline otherwise).
ben: will add the check to ci/smoke.sh; example check snippet: ```
# smoke.sh (add)
HIT_RATE=$(curl -s http://monitoring.internal/probe/hitrate?probe=gen-canary-001)
if [ "$HIT_RATE" -lt 90 ]; then echo "cache hit-rate below 90%"; exit 2; fi
```
alice: thanks. action items: 1) pin canary traffic (done), 2) open revert PR (carol), 3) add synthetic cache-hit guard (ben), 4) postmortem + tests (alice).
carol: PR opened: github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4182 (revert serializer commit). moving to review.
sre-oncall: leaving follow-up in #incidents and scheduling a 15-min post-deploy review in 30m.
alice: noted — will update release notes to mark v2.14.1-rc2 as blocked and add rollback instructions. :thumbsup:
monitoring-bot: Alert cleared: probe/high-latency (canary) — status=resolved.
ben: will run a local canary with migration and confirm before reattempting rollout.
alice: closing thread for now, will reopen if metrics regress.
